summary: Council adopted the City of Langford’s Climate Action Plan as presented. Council adopted Permissive Tax Exemption Bylaws No. 2284 and No. 2295. Council gave first, second and third readings to Subdivision and Development Servicing Bylaw No. 1000, Amendment No. 28 (Bylaw No. 2158). Council gave first, second and third readings to Solid Waste Collection Bylaw No. 2299, 2026; the motion carried with Mayor Scott Goodmanson opposed and multiple members of the public expressing concerns.
